sources.entry: Airmail - Fast email client. For both Mac OS and iOS.

summary.name: Airmail
summary.one_liner: Airmail is a customizable email client for iOS, macOS and watchOS that supports multiple account types, smart inbox filtering, snooze, scheduled sending and custom actions.
use_cases: manage several email accounts in one inbox
filter out newsletters and see important mail
schedule emails to arrive at a set time
automate email handling with rules and custom actions
send and search mail with Siri or Shortcuts
summary.what_it_does: Airmail is an email client for iOS, iPadOS, macOS and watchOS. It connects to Gmail, iCloud Mail, Exchange, Office 365, Outlook, IMAP and POP3 accounts and offers a unified inbox across them. A smart inbox filters out newsletters, and snooze hides emails until a chosen time. Users can build custom actions, rules and swipe actions, and schedule emails to send later. Privacy mode processes data locally, blocks tracking pixels and stops automatic image loading.
notable: Smart inbox that filters newsletters and distractions
Custom actions and App Intents integration with Siri, Shortcuts and Spotlight
Privacy mode that processes data locally and blocks tracking pixels
iCloud sync of settings, signatures and templates between iOS and Mac
caveats: Send Later and realtime inbox monitoring are not included in the Airmail Pro version for business, per the page
Some features are described as Apple-platform specific, so it is not available on Windows or Linux per the page
